question.text: Under SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020, Investment Approach refers to:

answer.text: The personal investment style of the principal officer
A broad outlay of the type of securities and permissible instruments for the investor
The risk appetite of the custodian

explanation.text: The Logic: IA is the documented outlay of instrument types, proportions and philosophy for clients. The Trap: Personal style of PO or custodian risk are separate concepts. Cross-Exam Context: Aligned with XXI-A Ch 7-8 and III-A Compliance. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Ensure every client is mapped to exactly one IA at onboarding.
